name: Imejis API
description: The endpoints an agent or integration calls directly. Render a design to a finished image (the image API), read and list designs, fetch a design's render config, check usage, and manage render keys. One endpoint renders: pass a design id, get an image back. Design authoring (the v2 component document) runs over MCP, so connect the MCP server at https://api.imejis.io/api/mcp and call get_design_guide for the full component schema.
